about.heading: One Day. One Community. Countless Possibilities.
about.subheading: The Culminating Leadership Project for Student Builders
about.description: AWS Student Community Day (SCD) is a premier one-day, student-led technical conference recognized in the AWS Playbook as the culminating capstone achievement for Student Builder Group Leaders. Unlike regular sessions, SCD brings together AWS Heroes, industry professionals, and student developers to provide real-world cloud exposure, ignite certification pathways, and celebrate builder culture.

faqs.question: What is the registration fee for AWS Student Community Day 2026?
faqs.answer: The registration fee is ₹45 per participant. This covers your event entry, attendee kit, session access, and verification credentials.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to attend?
faqs.answer: All college students from any branch or year who are interested in cloud computing, serverless architectures, and building technology can attend.

faqs.question: How will I receive my event entry pass?
faqs.answer: After you register at /community-day/register and your payment is confirmed, your digital entry pass with a unique QR code will be generated on 17–18 November and sent to your email address.

faqs.question: Are seats limited?
faqs.answer: Yes. Due to auditorium capacity, registration is strictly limited to 200 attendees on a first-come, first-served basis.

faqs.question: Will participants receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes, verified participants who attend the full-day summit will receive an official digital Certificate of Participation.
